note: The smokebush family of 0.9.164: how the smoke is drawn (drawSmokePlumes, look.smoke) and the Coppiced choice (look.coppice, the 'coppice' shrub habit). The shrub and tree sizes were already in the catalog and are MBG's; the coppiced sizes are estimates from the regrowth sources, recorded per row. Every coppiced drawing was solved from its species with dev/cultivar-size.cjs.

smoke.what: mbg: the smoke is not the flowers (tiny, yellowish, in terminal panicles 6-8 in long) but 'billowy hairs (attached to elongated stalks on the spent flower clusters) which turn a smokey pink to purplish pink in summer, thus covering the tree with fluffy, hazy, smoke-like puffs throughout summer'. tso: 'Fruiting panicle 15-20 cm tall, much branched and usually with long silky hairs after anthesis, typically pinkish to yellowish then pale greyish'; the hairs are 'light-trapping' and 'will always give this a silvery cast'.
smoke.drawn: A plume is a panicle at a shoot tip, held up and out: a darker thread up its axis and to each branch, lobes along the axis broad at the foot and rounding off at the tip, three translucent layers of haze (each one fill for the whole plant), a lit core and short silky hairs on the edge. It replaced four leaf-sized ovals per tip.
smoke.season: bloomMonths 6-8 for smokebush (mbg: 'throughout summer'); in Fall the plumes are drawn faded to grey in the seed colour, fewer, and thinning as the leaves drop; nothing in Winter (the old Winter seed colour drew brown berries on the bare twigs).
smoke.obovatus: tso: panicle c. 30 cm, 'more open and less showy than that of C. coggygria'; the heads 'do not ramify as densely and showily'; female trees hold theirs longer. Drawn with smokeOpen 0.7 (five wider-set lobes), smokeShare 0.55, smokeLen 1.45.
smoke.goldenSpirit: mbg: 'There are questions ... as to whether GOLDEN SPIRIT should be expected to flower and smoke in the garden'; its patent records no flowering in four years, though nurseries report some. Drawn with smokeShare 0.18.
smoke.grace: tso: 'Huge, deep-pink seed heads'; a hybrid of C. coggygria 'Velvet Cloak' and C. obovatus raised by Peter Dummer at Hillier in 1978, conventionally named Cotinus 'Grace'. Drawn with smokeLen 1.2 and a deeper pink.

coppice.what: finegardening: cut the stems back in winter to 6-8 in stubs, 'and can be done every year if you wish'. rhs: Cotinus is among the shrubs hard pruned for large leaves, in late winter or early spring. tso: 'Since Smokebushes flower from second-year wood, coppicing them annually destroys the display of seed-heads'; they 'respond to pruning with very vigorous and somewhat wayward shoots'. wikipedia (Sunset): 'first-year shoots up to 2 m tall with large handsome leaves, but no smoke'. mbg: 'stems may be cut back hard in early spring to a framework to induce growth of vigorous new shoots with larger than normal leaves'.
coppice.drawn: Winter: last summer's straight, bare shoots. Spring: at leaf stage 0 only the stool of stubs (stoolIn 7), then the shoots come up through the stages (COPPICE_SHOOT) to full height in Summer. Leaves leafHW 2.2 against the shrub's 1.35, about 1.6x as large. No bloom or seed in any season.

smokebush.estimates: mbg: 10-15 ft tall and wide; kept at the catalog's 12 ft.

smokebush|royalpurple.estimates: mbg: 10-15 ft tall, 15-20 ft wide; 'showy purplish puffs follow yellow flowers'.

smokebush|grace.estimates: The catalog's 15 ft; tso records 'arborescent if not coppiced'.

smokebush|younglady.estimates: mbg: 4-6 ft over the first 10 years, more floriferous than the species.

coppicedsmokebush.estimates: Shoots 'up to 2 m' in a season (wikipedia); a typical annually cut plant taken at 5.5 ft tall and 4 ft across. The width is an estimate: one season's shoots fan out from a stool, narrower than the shrub.

coppicedsmokebush|grace.estimates: The most vigorous Cotinus, half C. obovatus (tso); taken at 7 ft and 5 ft across, the top of the coppiced range.

coppicedsmokebush|goldenspirit.estimates: Slower than the green and purple forms (mbg gives it the smallest range of the three); taken at 4.5 ft.

smoketree.estimates: mbg: 20-30 ft; kept at the catalog's 25 ft.

notLeftIn.coppiced American smoketree: No source found describing C. obovatus grown coppiced; its hybrid 'Grace' is offered coppiced instead.
